name: Awa Shrine
description: A long-standing shrine in southern Tateyama, approached through mature trees and a large white torii; it is a distinct spiritual and seasonal stop from the nearby city-and-castle outing.
highlights: A large white torii and wooded approach to the main sanctuary
Cherry blossoms along the approach in early April

en.name: Awa Shrine
en.description: A long-standing shrine in southern Tateyama, approached through mature trees and a large white torii; it is a distinct spiritual and seasonal stop from the nearby city-and-castle outing.
highlights: A large white torii and wooded approach to the main sanctuary
Cherry blossoms along the approach in early April
en.notes: The shrine is not a Shiroyama Park component. The Tateyama City visitor page lists a 20-minute JR bus approach from Tateyama Station; this final-leg fact does not model an origin-to-destination duration.
en.reservation: General worship does not require a reservation; verify prayer or special-service arrangements directly with the shrine.
en.parking: Check official shrine or Tateyama visitor guidance for current parking conditions.
en.openingHours: Current Awa Shrine guidance: talismans and goshuin 08:30–16:30; specific prayers 09:00–16:00.

ja.name: 安房神社
ja.description: 南館山にある古社。大きな白い鳥居と古木の参道が印象的で、館山の城山公園とは異なる、信仰と季節の景観を楽しむ立ち寄り先です。
highlights: 大きな白い鳥居と木立に包まれた参道
館山南部で楽しむ独立した神社参拝
ja.notes: 城山公園の付属施設ではなく、独立した館山南部の神社です。館山市の案内では館山駅からJRバスで約20分ですが、この最終アクセス情報を出発地からの所要時間として扱いません。
ja.reservation: 通常の参拝に予約は不要です。祈祷など特別な利用は神社へ直接確認してください。
ja.parking: 駐車場の最新状況は神社または館山の公式観光案内で確認してください。
ja.openingHours: 安房神社の最新案内では、御朱印・神符授与は8:30〜16:30、祈祷などは9:00〜16:00です。
